status: Fixed before this script's new fits; old test results already exposed, so not prospective confirmation
selection: minimum validation all7 z-MSE; one frozen winner then one test evaluation per cell
notes: DLinear deliberately excluded from the expanded suite; present only as archived historical evidence.
All classical models consume all 104x7 standardized lag values; PCA-HistGB and PCA-SVR compress train targets to 8 PCA coordinates.
TimesNet uses unmodified vendored upstream model at pinned commit, compact configuration; not the original paper's optimized capacity.
No LLM or reasoning run is claimed by this configuration.
MSE_all7 must not be multiplied by the ILITOTAL variance; target-specific physical errors are computed separately.
